AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Establishment Planting Site? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Establishment Planting Site.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Establishment Planting Site.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Pollution? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Pollution.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Pollution.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Pollution.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Pollution.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Constructing Water Retention Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Constructing Water Retention Structures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Constructing Water Retention Structures.

10. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production ? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

14. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Food Nutrients? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Food Nutrients.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Food Nutrients.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Food Nutrients.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Food Nutrients.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene in Rearing Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Knitting Skills 10 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Laundry: Loose- coloured Items and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Knitting Skills 10 4.2 Constructing Framed Suspended Garden 10 4.3 Adding Value  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
